messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 45):
"""
50) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/062/03/2021 dated 24.3.2021 Extension of time lines - IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/235/09/2020dated 10- 09-2020 51) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/ 99 /04/2021 dated 22.4.2021 Circular to insurance companies to ensure cashless facility at all empaneled network providers. 46 52) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/102/04/2021 dated 23.4.2021 Emphasizing /reiterating existing provisions on Communication on settlement of health insurance claims. 53) 525/IRDAI/HLT/CK/2020-21 dated 10.5.2021 Availability and renewal of Standard Corona specific products due to the second wave of the Covid-19. 54) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/246/09/2021 dated 13.09.2021 Extension of the timelines for sale and renewal of short term Covid specific health insurance policies 31.03.2022 55) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/57/03/2022 dated 28.3.2022 Extension of he timelines for sale and renewal of short term Covid specific health insurance policies.-31.09.2022
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"When was the extension of timelines for sale and renewal of short term Covid specific health insurance policies granted?","answer":"The extension was granted on 28.3.2022.","facts":["IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/57/03/2022 dated 28.3.2022 Extension of the timelines for sale and renewal of short term Covid specific health insurance policies.-31.09.2022"]},{"question":"Which circular instructs insurance companies to ensure cashless facility at all empaneled network providers?","answer":"The circular is IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/99/04/2021 dated 22.4.2021.","facts":["IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/ 99 /04/2021 dated 22.4.2021 Circular to insurance companies to ensure cashless facility at all empaneled network providers."]}]}
